message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for 9×13 in. pan) |
|----------|------------|-----------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | • Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (≈ 450 g) |
| | • Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | • Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | • Crushed tomatoes (canned or passata) | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | • Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | • Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | • Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | • Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | • Salt & pepper | to taste |
| | • Optional: red pepper flakes, bay leaf, or a splash of red wine | as desired |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella (part‑mozzarella or part‑cheddar blend) | 3–4 cups (≈ 300 g) |
| **Parmesan topping** | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Optional extras** | • Spinach (fresh or sautéed) | 2 cups |
| | • Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | • Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | • Ricotta‑spinach blend | 1 cup |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if not no‑boil) until al dente, then drain and lay flat on a sheet of parchment.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, herbs, and seasonings; simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare ricotta mix**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, parsley, salt, pepper.
4. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta mix, mozzarella, repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce and mozzarella.
5. **Top**: Sprinkle extra Parmesan.
6. **Bake**: 375 °F (190 °C) for 35–45 min, covered with foil for the first 30 min, then uncovered to brown the top.
7. **Rest**: Let sit 10–15 min before slicing.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
